title: Flow run result
description:
GET /api/bridge/runs/{runId}, and the terminal payload a consumer stores.

A run must NEVER report `succeeded` when a step could not do what it was asked. Substituting a default, skipping the node or passing input through unchanged produces a green run and silently wrong data, which is the most expensive failure mode this system has.

status.description: Terminal states are immutable; a second finalise is 409.

output.description: The flow result. Present only when status is `succeeded`.

idempotent.description: True when this request matched an existing run and nothing new executed.

runtime.description: Where execution happens. A capability is offered by a runtime, not by the platform in the abstract.

claimedBy.description: Device/worker that won the claim. Doubles as a device label in run history.
